Jasmine (Finance): Heads up — incoming wire from 'Acme Incorporated' arrived today but our bank feed shows payee as 'ACME, Inc' and the reference was truncated to 'INV-98765/202'. Reconciliation failed in our system (matching by exact payee + reference). Bank says remittance field is blank. Copy of MT103 pasted below.

Jasmine (Finance): ```
:20:TRN123456789
:32A:240318USD15000,
:50K:/12345678
Acme Incorporated
:59:/987654321
ACME, Inc
:70:INV-98765/2024 PO# 2091...
```

Marco (Accounting): Ugh — looks like payee name variation + ref truncation. Can you forward the original sender's payment advice? If we have the invoice/PO number on the advice we can force a manual match.

Liam (Support): @Jasmine any chance the customer used a different account name on their side? If so, banks often normalize names differently. I can run a fuzzy match on ledger entries for the last 30 days.

Jasmine (Finance): I emailed the customer but they replied saying their TMS created the remittance and included PO 2091 and invoice 98765. They attached a PDF but the bank's MT103 shows the :70: trimmed by SWIFT to 28 chars. PDF includes full "Invoice 98765 / PO 2091". Attaching snippet.

Sasha (CS): Customer says treasury team will confirm the trace ref (they gave us a partial trace: TRN123456789). I'll ask them for the full beneficiary reference and any bank copy.

Marco (Accounting): In the meantime, can we create a temporary manual reconciliation rule: if incoming amount \u003d invoice amount AND beneficiary account matches AND payee fuzzy-match score >= 80% AND invoice number appears in attached customer remittance PDF, mark as matched? This would prevent ageing.

Liam (Support): I can run a quick script to search attachments for invoice numbers and flag candidates. Sample query: ``SELECT tx.id FROM payments tx JOIN attachments a ON a.payment_id=tx.id WHERE a.text LIKE '%98765%' AND tx.amount=15000;``

Jasmine (Finance): Please run it. Also, bank is requesting a beneficiary name correction request for future wires. Can we add guidance to invoices: "Please put full invoice and PO number in payment reference and use beneficiary name 'Acme Incorporated'"?

payments-bot: Payment TRN123456789 recorded to ledger entry #8421. Status: unapplied.

Liam (Support): Script results: found ledger #8421 with attachment that mentions "Invoice 98765" and PO 2091. I'll flag it for Marco.

Marco (Accounting): Manually matched and applied payment to invoice 98765. Closing as reconciled. Action items: 1) Ask customer to resend the MT103 (full trace) for our records. 2) Ops to add invoice payment guidance on next invoice batch. 3) Support to add a fuzzy-match fallback task in reconciliation runbook.

Jasmine (Finance): Thanks team — closing the ticket on our side after we get the MT103. Noting this for the next AR batch: add a one-line reminder under 'Payment Instructions' and include example reference format. :memo: :white_check_mark:

Sasha (CS): I'll follow up with the customer for the MT103 and confirm they updated their TMS rules.

Marco (Accounting): Resolved in ledger. Leaving note: "manual reconcile due to truncated SWIFT reference and payee name variant". If this recurs >3x escalate to payments partner for parsing rules.

Jasmine (Finance): last note — created internal ticket PAY-4023 to implement fuzzy fallback and attachment scanning. Closing thread.
